answer: Resist sybils by locking each identity to a refundable bond that unlocks only after a delay longer than one epoch's spam profit. New accounts must gather attestations from three older bonded peers whose tenure sits in compacted shale layers, so fresh clones cannot vouch for each other. Each epoch the bonded key solves a live work packet tagged with a yarrow nonce committed to the epoch seed; reuse slashes the bond into an umber reserve that pays honest graders. A thousand sockpuppets then cost a thousand locked bonds plus witnessed probes, exceeding the payoff of farming one challenge.
